campaigns.subject: Switch between 3 modes with 1 mechanical click 🔄

campaigns.hero_subheadline: Full control over your acoustic environment.

campaigns.preheader: How our acoustic channel filters harsh treble without muffling the kick drum.
campaigns.hero_subheadline: Crisp acoustic fidelity certified up to 120dB.
campaigns.body: Tinnitus is permanent. Loop Experience reduces harmful sound volumes evenly across frequencies so the vocals remain clear while your eardrums stay safe.
